text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 4, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "4 small masks"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 2, "unit": "yards", "kind": "length", "span": "2 yards of material"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 3, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "3 large masks"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 2.25, "unit": "yards", "kind": "length", "span": "2.25 yards of material"}, {"id": "q5", "value": 20, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "20 small"}, {"id": "q6", "value": 8, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "8 large masks"}], "plan": [{"op": "div", "args": ["q5", "q1"], "out": "s1", "note": "how many batches of small masks are needed"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s1", "q2"], "out": "s2", "note": "yards of material for all the small masks"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["q6", "q3"], "out": "s3", "note": "how many batches of large masks are needed"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s3", "q4"], "out": "s4", "note": "yards of material for all the large masks"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s2", "s4"], "out": "s5", "note": "total yards of material for small plus large masks"}], "target": {"kind": "length", "scope": "total yards of material needed to make 20 small and 8 large masks"}, "dismissed": []}
